messages.content: open the tic tac toe game

function.name: workflow_orchestrator
function.arguments: {"type": "sequential", "steps": [{"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "find \"$profile.workspace\" -type f -iname '*tic*tac*toe*' -o -iname '*tictactoe*' -o -iname '*tic*tac*' | head -n 1"}, "store_result_as": "$path"}, {"type": "conditional", "condition": {"field": "$path.stdout", "operator": "==", "value": ""}, "if_true": {"type": "parallel", "steps": [{"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "find ~/ -type f -iname '*tictactoe*' -o -iname '*tic*tac*toe*' | head -n 1"}, "store_result_as": "$alt_home"}, {"tool": "shell_exec", "args": {"command": "find / -type f -iname '*tictactoe*' -o -iname '*tic*tac*toe*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1"}, "store_result_as": "$alt_root"}], "then": {"type": "conditional", "condition": {"field": "$alt_home.stdout", "operator": "!=", "value": ""}, "if_true": {"tool": "app_open", "args": {"target": "$alt_home.stdout"}}, "if_false": {"tool": "app_open", "args": {"target": "$alt_root.stdout"}}}}, "if_false": {"tool": "app_open", "args": {"target": "$path.stdout"}}}]}
